maddeler.e:
انكفأت (form VII)
# اِنْكَفَأْتُ (inkafaʔtu) /in.ka.faʔ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْكَفَأَ (inkafaʔa)
# اِنْكَفَأْتَ (inkafaʔta) /in.ka.faʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْكَفَأَ (inkafaʔa)
# اِنْكَفَأْتِ (inkafaʔti) /in.ka.faʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْكَفَأَ (inkafaʔa)
# اِنْكَفَأَتْ (inkafaʔat) /in.ka.fa.ʔat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
